systems_found: Utah System of Higher Education (USHE): University of Utah, Utah State University (incl. USU Eastern, Blanding), Weber State, Southern Utah, Utah Valley, Utah Tech, Snow College, Salt Lake Community College; plus Utah technical colleges

sources.institution: All USHE institutions and technical colleges (each reports as its own entity)
sources.system: Transparent Utah (Office of the State Auditor)
sources.download_url: No static file URL. The Compensation Downloader builds a zipped CSV per entity and fiscal year via an undocumented query service at https://tu-query-handler-prod-uewlhjwsua-wm.a.run.app (query name getEntityCompensationZip, used by static/js/alex_queries.js). The page also offers CSV/XLSX/JSON export buttons for the preview table.
sources.coverage_years: About FY2010 to FY2025, varies by entity (annual compensation reports are due 90 days after fiscal year end)
sources.institutions_covered: All public colleges and universities in Utah, plus all state and local government entities
sources.employees: all (at-risk employees may be redacted on request)
sources.size: not stated; large entities (University of Utah, USU, SLCC) are zipped and take up to 1 minute to generate
sources.terms: Disclaimers page (old.transparent.utah.gov/disclaimers.php); no explicit reuse restriction seen
sources.notes: robots.txt allows everything. You pick an entity and year in a dropdown: no login, account or CAPTCHA. Rated A because it returns a full bulk CSV per entity-year. Data is long format: one row per employee per pay type (wages, benefits, etc.), so it has to be pivoted. There is no department name, only org codes. The new React site at transparent.utah.gov has the same data. I did not test the endpoint, to avoid form-style calls.

sources.system: Transparent Utah - Employee Pay Search / Highest Paid
sources.blocker: Name search only; it duplicates the bulk downloader.

sources.institution: University of Utah, Utah State University, others
sources.size: about 740k-760k records stated in search snippets
sources.blocker: Third-party copy of Transparent Utah data, paginated HTML; the official bulk source is better.

private_extra: None found. BYU and Westminster publish no pay data beyond the IRS 990.
gaps: No department names (only org codes). No hire date or FTE. No documented static bulk URLs: each entity-year export is generated on demand.
notes: I rated the Transparent Utah downloader A even though you have to pick an entity and year in the UI. It is public, needs no login or CAPTCHA, and returns full bulk files. I treated login_or_form as false because no form gates access. No single-university salary pages were found: the USU library points users to Transparent Utah.
